decision_rule: n_triples < MIN_SCORABLE -> INSUFFICIENT (the model did not answer in the requested format often enough to score); else flip_rate < 0.10 or > 0.90 -> CEILING_OR_FLOOR (retune framing before spending GPU on probes); else IN_BAND
notes: flip = sign change between PRO and ANTI (BINARY) or |PRO-ANTI| > 2.0 (SCALE). Unsigned: it does not distinguish which pole was followed, so the signed halves are carried alongside it. Items whose answer mass fell below MASS_FLOOR in ANY framing are dropped, not scored.
